meta.name: lovable
meta.description: Lovable MCP tool usage — deploy projects, message agent, test with agent-browser. Minimize credits by delegating to local repo.

copy.tagline: 用 MCP 工具部署项目、测试应用、管理本地仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开发中通过 MCP 工具部署和测试项目
copy.tagline_en: Deploy projects, test apps, and manage local repos via MCP tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy and test projects using MCP tools during development

howto.what: Claude 可以部署 Lovable 项目、向 Lovable 代理发送指令、用 agent-browser 测试网站，并优先在本地编辑以节省积分。
howto.when: 当你需要管理或测试 Lovable 项目时，例如部署、发送消息或查看分析数据。

say.text: 列出我所有已发布的项目及其访问量。
say.note: 调用 list_projects 获取项目列表和访问统计。

say.text: 部署项目 ID 为 abc123 的网站。
say.note: 调用 deploy_project 部署指定项目。

say.text: 向项目 abc123 发送消息：将首页标题改为“欢迎”。

howto.what_en: Claude can deploy Lovable projects, send messages to the Lovable agent, test sites with agent-browser, and prioritize local edits to save credits.
howto.when_en: When you need to manage or test a Lovable project, e.g., deploy, send a message, or view analytics.

say_en.text: List all my published projects with visitor counts.
say_en.note: Calls list_projects to get project list and stats.
Calls deploy_project to deploy the specified project.

say_en.text: Send message to project abc123: change homepage title to 'Welcome'.
say_en.note: Calls send_message to instruct the Lovable agent.
